reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept FUNCTION LOG followed by exactly one parenthesised numeric argument-1 (literal, data item or arithmetic expression) and refuse every other shape: no argument list, an empty list, two arguments, an ALL-subscripted table argument, a keyword-omitted form.
